messages:
alex: onboarding HF model 'galatea-13b' — conversion smoke tests failed on generation and tokenization. redwood convert completed but runtime -> model mismatch when serving. Strange tokens in outputs like <|special_unk|>.

maria: can you paste the converted config.json? my hunch is rope_scaling/sliding_window schema differences again — saw a weird shape in HF release notes.

alex: snippet from converted config.json (from convert tool):

```json
{
  \"model_type\": \"causal\",
  \"num_attention_heads\": 64,
  \"num_key_value_heads\": 32,
  \"max_position_embeddings\": 2048,
  \"rope_scaling\": 0.5,
  \"sliding_window\": true
}
```

alex: convert tool output didn't normalize `rope_scaling` to our expected object format. also tokenizer added 9 specials pushing effective positions past 2048 during some long chats and got truncated.

jonathan: ok two separate bugs that combined to produce the regression:
- `rope_scaling` in HF config is a float (legacy), our loader expects an object like `{"type": "linear", "factor": 0.5}`. when it's numeric we currently ignore it -> attention math mismatch at inference time.
- `sliding_window` set to boolean vs expected `{"enabled": true, "window_size": 1024}`. boolean causes default window_size=0 in our runtime -> KV cache misaligns on long contexts.

sam: also `num_key_value_heads` being 32 while `num_attention_heads` is 64 is technically ok if KV heads are a divisor, but our serving runtime expects `num_attention_heads % num_key_value_heads == 0` and then computes `heads_per_kv = 2`. the conversion didn't include an explicit `heads_per_kv` field so runtime falls back to 1 -> shape mismatch when building KV tensors.

alex: repro commands I ran:

```
# conversion
redwood convert --hf model_dir/galatea-13b -o /tmp/galatea_conv
# run smoke generation
redwood serve --model /tmp/galatea_conv &
curl -sS localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello world"}' | jq .
```

ci-bot: build: conversion succeeded, unit-tests: 42 passed, 3 failed (config-interop). See CI: https://ci.redwood/internal/5421

maria: quick mitigation suggestions:
- update convert to normalize `rope_scaling` into object form AND emit a conversion warning in metadata.
- coerce `sliding_window: true` -> `{"enabled":true, "window_size": default_window}` with default_window derived from model's max_position_embeddings or a conservative value (1024).
- compute and write explicit `heads_per_kv` when `num_key_value_heads` present.

jonathan: agree. also we should add a checker in onboarding e2e that runs short convo generation through tokenizer -> convert -> serve -> compare logits to HF baseline for a few tokens (fast smoke). that would catch rope/scaling math drift early.

eval-bot: ran quant experiments on the converted artifact: 4-bit qint8-style quant gave ~7% perplexity regression vs float16 baseline and introduced token prefixes in ~2% of outputs when sliding_window was boolean. full report: https://eval.redwood/reports/galatea-13b-quant-2026-03

sam: filing a tiny RFC/PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard/pull/987 — conversion: normalize schemas + add tests to onboarding smoke harness. ping @maria for review.

alex: temporary workaround pushed to staging: conversion now maps rope_scaling numeric -> object and sliding_window boolean -> object; servicing team please monitor 13b canary (staging) for latency regressions.

maria: thanks. I'll add a regression test that tokenizes long prompt with special tokens included to ensure max_position_embeddings padding/truncation logic doesn't silently drop tokens.

jonathan: follow-ups: (1) add explicit validation errors instead of silent fallbacks, (2) add a mapping table for known HF schema quirks (we've seen three variants of rope_scaling already), (3) capture original hf config in convert metadata blob.

alex: perfect. leaving notes in the onboarding ticket: https://tickets.redwood/ONB-4321 — tagging this thread for visibility. :pray:

ci-bot: note: new test failures will be flagged under ONB-4321 once PR lands.
